name: signaltrace
description: Read-only, evidence-backed audits of AI discoverability, citation destinations, and post-referral engagement.

interface.shortDescription: Trace what AI can find, prove, and send visitors to.
interface.longDescription: Audit a public website without modifying it. SignalTrace inspects structured data, answer-bearing HTML, citation destinations, and explicitly supplied external sources under a robots-aware request budget.
defaultPrompt: Use SignalTrace to audit this public URL and return one evidence-backed JSON report.
